digest.component_or_area: Jira DataCenter backend assembly and port conformance
propositions: JiraDataCenterBackend does not implement query_project and assert_env_ready, so isinstance(backend, Backend) returns False despite the backend being registered
The DC backend is registered in the adapter registry but unreachable via config because reconciler.backend validator only accepts 'jira', not 'jira-datacenter'

DC inbound identity minting never attempts to mint when assignees lack accountId, and even if fixed would fail on invalid creation_channel 'jira-datacenter' which is not in CREATION_CHANNELS vocabulary
The backend contract suite fixture parameters include only 'fake' and 'jira' backends, so the registered DC backend has never been validated against the port

Writing-mode reconcile passes crash with 'JiraDataCenterTransport' object has no attribute 'set_entity_property' because the method is called from three core sites but is not declared in the TicketTransport Protocol
